title: Mr.Ducky Studio is founded
body: We team up on our first title, Super Adventure Obby — the project where we both learned the basics of Roblox development.

title: The Squid Game
body: Fresh off our first game, we jump on the Squid Game trend right as it peaks. It becomes our first real hit.

title: Going solo for a while
body: With the hype settled, we split off onto our own projects to sharpen up — Aymen builds Wordly, Mohomesad builds Fall Block.

title: Working with Tiny Comet
body: Tiny Comet finds our earlier games and brings us on to work for them on Nation Survival. This is where we really learn game design and how to tackle hard problems.

title: Chained Up
body: Back on our own games, we ship Chained Up — a co-op climb inspired by Chained Together, and our second big hit.

title: Working with Altera
body: We work for Altera on AI Friendzone. On the side, our own Liar's Game climbs past 2K concurrent players — and Altera acquires it, relaunching it as Truths Table with AI agents.

title: The Squid Game, round two
body: Netflix drops Season 2 and our 2021 game explodes to 13K+ concurrent players. We start a full revamp.

title: The Squid Game, round three
body: Season 3 pushes the game to new visit records and the community grows past 600K members.

title: Untitled Golf Game
body: Our newest game: fast, chaotic multiplayer golf where you race other players across the course.
